closure_policy: No new theorem from this branch may be promoted unless it closes, invalidates, or explicitly demotes an objection-ledger item.

theorem_status.promotion_condition: Use tagged query/dictionary records and masked query extraction after sort.
Keep the batched lookup improvement and add external anchors plus nonvacuity examples.
Add matching examples or a proof-system extraction theorem.
Add rank/nonvacuity hypotheses and examples separating quotient from occurrence.

Add examples, rank/expansion hypotheses, or demote the SAT carrier to conditional motivation.
Add query/dictionary tags or masks, propagate dictionary values, and aggregate only query records.
Give explicit upper bounds/separations where possible and demote claims where not possible.
